title: Predicting short-term mortality in sepsis-associated acute kidney injury: an explainable machine learning model with a web-based prototype
summary: The primary publisher Methods/Results support the AI-enabled result: Unverified Haiku assessment. Retrospective cohort of 773 critically ill sepsis-associated AKI patients with an explainable machine learning mortality model, a clinically specific reference assessment with an identified learned-model role. The result is reported in the Scientific Reports. Affiliation was not stated in the reviewed material. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
